project: B2B Sport - Content Credibility & Layout Fixes
description: Replace unverifiable statistics with honest language, transform partner section into brand showcase, and fix ValueProposition to not look like pricing tiers

userStories.title: Replace 50+ klubber statistics with honest language
userStories.description: As marketing, I want to replace specific club numbers with vaguer but honest language so we don't get caught making claims we can't back up.
acceptanceCriteria: Welcome component: Replace '50+ klubber' badge with honest alternative (e.g., 'Voksende netværk' or 'Nye partnere')
Welcome component: Replace 'Stolte partnere' title with something like 'Bliv en del af rejsen' or 'Klubber der er med'
Experience component: Replace '50+ Stolte klubpartnere' stat with capability-focused message (e.g., 'Klar til din klub')
ValueProposition component: Remove the '50+ klubber' social proof from featured card
Update all three dictionary files (da.json, en.json, de.json) with equivalent translations
npm run typecheck passes
Visual verification: Run npm run dev, navigate to http://localhost:3000/da and confirm no '50+' text appears anywhere on homepage

userStories.title: Transform partner section into supplier brands showcase
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see which equipment brands B2B Sport works with so I understand they have legitimate supplier relationships.
acceptanceCriteria: Welcome component right card: Replace fake partner avatars with concept of 'brands we work with'
Show 3-4 placeholder brand icon shapes (styled monotone circles/squares) that can be swapped for real logos later
Update card title to 'Anerkendte brands' or 'Kvalitetsbrands' or similar
Maintain the decorative corner bracket styling
Update all three dictionary files (da.json, en.json, de.json)
npm run typecheck passes
Visual verification: Run npm run dev, navigate to http://localhost:3000/da and confirm the right card in Welcome section shows brand-related content instead of partner avatars

userStories.title: Remove pricing-tier appearance from ValueProposition
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to understand the three cards as features/benefits, not as mutually exclusive pricing plans.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove 'Anbefalet' badge from the middle card - use a descriptive badge instead
Remove the elevated styling (-translate-y-4) from featured card - make all cards equal height
Change all cards to same background style (all use light background)
Remove the ring border that makes middle card look premium
All three CTAs should point to /contact
Update badge text to be feature-descriptive (e.g., 'Digital', 'Support', 'Partnerskab')
Update all three dictionary files if badge text changes
npm run typecheck passes
Visual verification: Run npm run dev, navigate to http://localhost:3000/da and confirm three cards appear equal with no elevated or highlighted card

userStories.title: Refine ValueProposition section header
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want the section title to clearly communicate these are platform capabilities, not service tiers.
acceptanceCriteria: Update section title to something clearer about capabilities (e.g., 'Alt hvad din klub har brug for' or 'Platform. Support. Partnerskab.')
Subtitle should reinforce these are features you get together, not plans you choose between
Update all three dictionary files (da.json, en.json, de.json)
npm run typecheck passes
Visual verification: Run npm run dev, navigate to http://localhost:3000/da and confirm new section header text appears
